message:
The users test now passes, and `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 failures.

The migration `001_create_users.js` names the column `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` read and wrote `full_name`. That mismatch caused the "unknown column users.full_name" error. I changed the API to use `fullname` in `createUser` and `getUser`. I didn't touch anything in `migrations/`.
